results.name: The Interns
results.overview: Witness the life of four young medical interns who experience various hilarious situations every day with their mentor and the hospital staff.

results.name: The Interns
results.overview: The Interns is an American medical drama series that aired on CBS from 1970 to 1971. It was based on the 1962 film The Interns and the 1964 sequel The New Interns.

results.name: Interns
results.overview: Following sanitary measures, the doctors holding the internal medicine service at the Raymond-Poincaré hospital find themselves confined to their homes for 48 hours. Three inexperienced interns and a medical examiner, who do not yet know each other, will have to work together to manage the service and the patients alone. But the quarantine continues...

results.title: The Interns
results.overview: During their first year of internship at New North Hospital, a group of aspiring doctors undergo both personal and professional upheavals.

results.title: The New Interns
results.overview: Young doctors mix romance with their careers in a big-city hospital.

results.title: The Sweet Interns
results.overview: The love and friendship adventures of seven internship medical students.

results.name: Scrubs: Interns
results.overview: Sunny, a whiz in both Pre-Med and Film, makes a video diary for her mother of her first year at Sacred Heart. She follows herself, Howie, Katie, Ed, and Denise and they learn the ropes at the hospital.

results.title: Interns
results.overview: Three friends begin their first experience as independent adults. As they sign the rent contract, they sell their souls to their situation. The three flatmates celebrate, optimist, their new life stage, with begins with ingenuity, good vibes and some savings. This happiness continues when one of them is named "employee of the month". At this point, the young adults forget their new responsibilities, making them lose their jobs and realise they should have read the terms and conditions of the adult world with more attention.

results.name: The Interns
results.original_name: หมอ มือ ใหม่
results.overview: A group of newly graduated doctors begin their internships at Maharak Hospital. Lin hopes to impress Dr. Thida, the country's most famous brain surgeon so that he'll pick her as his protégé. Pawin is the pillar of his family. With his family facing financial troubles, he works hard to take amazing care of all his patients. Emmi is the heiress of an importing business that moves medical equipment. She means to make connections in order to profit from future business in the medical industry. Ket is chasing her dream of being a doctor who treats all patients equally, regardless of gender identity. Best has high ideals; he has a love for what is right. He became a doctor out of a desire to make changes in the system, wanting everyone to receive equal treatment. He doesn't want to see anyone die hopelessly as his little sister did.

results.name: The Interns
results.overview: Welcome to the lives of three young interns of Digital Diva. They come with their own set of drama. Come ride along and watch these girls power through their internship and their lives.

results.name: We Are Medical Interns
results.overview: Ryuji Ameno graduated from a medical school out in a province. He is now a doctor-in-training in the surgery department at a hospital in Tokyo. Every day, he is scolded by senior doctors for not being able to do something or know something. Ryuji Ameno feels helpless when he sees patients and their families, because the patients and their families think he is a doctor. Ryuji Ameno feels he is unable to satisfy their expectations. He cries over patients that he is unable to save, but he never loses his strong will and passion to become a doctor. Ryuji Ameno grows into a real doctor with his fellow doctors-in-training.

results.name: Resident: Story of 5 Interns
results.original_name: レジデント〜5人の研修医
results.overview: Patients are brought in one after the other. Being put in an environment where there is a race against time to save lives, all they can do is stand there doing nothing. Though they still have a lot to grow as a doctor and as individuals, will they be able to overcome adversity and one day be able to proudly identify themselves as being a doctor?

results.title: Night School for Interns
results.overview: A nurse gets the hots for a female patient and soon a pervert is spying on them.

results.name: The Interns Show
results.overview: The Interns presented by Allied Insurance, is a reality TV show designed to seek potential talent and skill for the marketing and advertising industry. In each episode teams will be assigned projects related to marketing, including social media & cause marketing. Each team consists of 5 students from each institute. The winning team will be rewarded with a guaranteed job from Allied Insurance & sponsors along with other prizes. During the show other companies can also express interest for specific interns and these will be updated in every show.

results.name: E-Vet Interns
results.overview: E-Vet Interns is a reality television series about veterinary interns working at Alameda East Veterinary Hospital in Denver, Colorado. It is a spinoff of Emergency Vets, a series about the lives of veterinarians at Alameda East that aired from 1998 to 2002 on the U.S. cable network Animal Planet. E-Vet Interns began airing on January 22, 2007, also on Animal Planet.

results.title: Blue Experience:  Interns in Love
results.original_title: 蒼い体験 恋するインターン
results.overview: University student Nonoka is job-hunting with her sights set on the advertising industry. However, she struggles to present herself effectively in interviews and is on the verge of losing confidence. Supporting and encouraging her are her best friend Azusa, who has already secured a job offer, and her carefree boyfriend Akira.　One day, Azusa arranges a drinks gathering to cheer Nonoka up. There, she encounters Ōshiro, a male student she previously shared an interview venue with, and they become excited by this chance reunion.

results.title: This Year's Interns
results.overview: In this workplace comedy, Aaron, an easygoing intern, and Jayden, his arrogant and overly competitive coworker, are wrapping up their final week at a marketing firm. With only one full-time position up for grabs, tension between the two escalates. When Aaron is tasked with getting the boss's birthday cake, Jayden seizes the opportunity to sabotage him. Their fierce rivalry spirals into a series of chaotic and hilarious office mishaps as both interns scramble to outdo each other in a last-ditch effort to secure the job.

results.name: I Witness: Medical Interns
results.overview: HMO's budget cuts, hospital closing, overworked house staff - the American health care system is under siege and it's not likely to be fixed anytime soon. Still, young idealistic kids, with images of "E.R." floating in their heads are becoming doctors.
